mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.08% is indicative of an ultra-low interest rate environment that supports equity valuations through compressed discount rates, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the current low-rate environment are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 270 and the federal funds rate remains below 0.1%, the low real interest rate environment supports equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (CPIAUCSL>270 and FEDFUNDS<0.1%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness indicated by unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strong economic conditions that support equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE is below 4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods when HOUST falls below 1500 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current industrial production index at 100.0178 is above the 100 baseline, indicating strong industrial activity that supports economic growth and positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO is above 100 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1500 and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceed 600,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer demand and housing market, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods meeting the condition (HOUST>1500 and RSAFS>600000) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 signals a significant economic slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO falls below 95 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
